topic: Hummingbird: the only bird that can fly backwards; its heart can beat over 1,000 times a minute.

episode.title: Wild Superpowers: Pip Flies Backwards!

shots.narration: Did you know one bird has a backwards flying superpower?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated tropical garden, emerald leaves framing a tiny hummingbird with a ruby-red throat, no text.
shots.action: pip hovers between two sunlit flowers.

shots.narration: Meet Pip, our tiny hummingbird explorer!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny tropical garden path, brown-skinned boy wearing a green safari hat, binoculars and a pocketed khaki vest beside an emerald hummingbird.

shots.narration: [surprised] That flower is behind him, with little room to turn!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, side view of a leafy garden alcove, pip facing the opening with a pink flower directly behind his tail.
shots.action: pip hovers in the narrow gap between soft leaves.

shots.narration: No turning needed: Pip simply flies backwards!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clear side view of the same leafy alcove and pink flower behind pip.
shots.action: pip flies tail-first toward the flower without turning.
shots.mood: Magical discovery grounded in natural movement.

shots.narration: Hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backwards.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open space beside the leafy alcove, sunlit pink blossoms and soft green jungle background.
shots.action: pip flies backwards out into the open garden.
shots.mood: Triumphant, clear view of shimmering emerald feathers.

shots.narration: [excited] Its heart can beat over 1,000 times a minute!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, natural close-up of pip beside a pink blossom, ruby-red throat and feathered chest visible, no diagrams or symbols.
shots.action: pip hovers steadily beside the blossom.

shots.narration: Such a tiny bird, such extraordinary superpowers!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, garden clearing, kiko beside hovering pip, lush leaves softly blurred behind them.
shots.action: kiko raises his binoculars to watch pip.

shots.narration: That tricky little space was no problem for Pip!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny garden beside the leafy alcove, pip hovering freely near kiko.
shots.mood: Warm celebration, bright flowers and relaxed smiles.

shots.narration: [excited] Which animal's real superpower comes next? Make your guess!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, tropical garden path winding toward distant green mountains, kiko and pip facing the viewer, no text.
shots.action: kiko extends an open palm toward the viewer.
shots.mood: Inviting curiosity, sunny promise of another adventure.

episode.endHook: Which animal’s real superpower will we discover next? Make your guess!
episode.description: Kiko discovers Pip’s amazing hummingbird superpowers when a flower is tricky to reach. Hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backwards, and their hearts can beat over 1,000 times a minute!
